headline: TRAFFIC CHAOS
ticker: MOTORWAY REPORTS ZERO CARS, ONE CONE
CONE RESCUED BY OFF-DUTY BUS DRIVER
TRAFFIC EXPERTS BLAME EVERYONE BEING AT HOME
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE TAXI DRIVER HAS VIEWS ON THIS

beats.text: Travel chaos tonight. Chase Hurley is live on the motorway, where it is a traffic APOCALYPSE.
Brock, I've been out here since four, and I have never seen anything like it.
Not one car. Not ONE. The silence is DEAFENING. Somebody has knocked over a cone.
Chase, it's a bank holiday. Everyone is at home.
Wait. A vehicle. A BUS. It's... it's Terry from Transport. He's waving.
Terry is supposed to be in the studio. He's on the rota.
Terry has stopped. He's picking up the cone. Brock, the cone is BACK UP, the cone is
CHASE. This is the greatest report in the history of news.
It's a cone, Brock. It is ONE. CONE.

realStory.text: Made up. Empty roads on a bank holiday are real enough; reporting them as an apocalypse is the joke. Terry has been reminded about the rota.
